sourceText:
Banana Oatmeal Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, March 11, 2010 - 12:56am

Ingredients




3/4 cup Margarine, softened
1 cup Bananas, mashed
1 Egg white, whipped
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1/2 cup Granulated sugar
1/2 cup Brown sugar, packed
1 1/2 cups Unbleached flour
1/4 teaspoon Salt
1/2 teaspoon Nutmeg
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon Cloves
1 teaspoon Baking powder
1 cup Rolled oats

Preparation

1 Preheat oven at 375. Prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a mixing bowl, combine margarine, bananas, egg white, and vanilla. In another mixing bowl, combine sugars, flour, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves, baking powder, and rolled oats. Drop by tablespoons 2" apart onto prepared baking sheet. 2 Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden. 3 NOTES : These are a soft cake like cookie.
